card: Removes the configure-time introspection check for SetThreadDescription and calls it unconditionally on Windows, documents MinGW-w64 12.0 as the minimum required version, and drops MSVCRT support from the Nix cross-shell. Following the 33.x release branch, master requires MinGW-w64 >= 12.0, making the compatibility probe introduced in #36057 unnecessary. This is an internal build configuration cleanup and documentation update.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; rebased or updated commit metadata.
evidence: PR description: 'A follow-up reverting #36057, now that we\'ve branched off for 33.x. Also documents mingw-w64 requirements (#32380).'
Removed CMake comment from #36057: 'Check for SetThreadDescription(), which is missing from mingw-w64 headers before 12.0.0.'
problem: A configure-time check for SetThreadDescription was added in #36057 as a temporary compatibility measure for older MinGW-w64 versions prior to branching 33.x. With the branch completed and master requiring MinGW-w64 12.0 or newer, the probe is obsolete, the requirement was missing from build documentation, and Nix tooling still maintained unnecessary MSVCRT configurations.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause Windows compilation failures on outdated MinGW toolchains that lack SetThreadDescription.

summary: Removes the CMake configure-time check for SetThreadDescription and calls it unconditionally on Windows. Also documents the MinGW-w64 12.0 minimum requirement in the Windows build guide and drops legacy MSVCRT build support from the Nix cross-compilation shell.
